requirements.quote:
A security-aware resolver MUST include an EDNS ([RFC2671]) OPT
   pseudo-RR with the DO ([RFC3225]) bit set when sending queries.
requirements.condition: When a security-aware resolver sends a query.
requirements.required_behavior: The security-aware resolver MUST include an EDNS OPT pseudo-RR in the query.
requirements.why_checkable: An outgoing query can be inspected for the presence of an EDNS OPT pseudo-RR.

requirements.quote:
A security-aware resolver MUST include an EDNS ([RFC2671]) OPT
   pseudo-RR with the DO ([RFC3225]) bit set when sending queries.
requirements.condition: When a security-aware resolver sends a query.
requirements.required_behavior: The security-aware resolver MUST set the DO bit in the query's EDNS OPT pseudo-RR.
requirements.why_checkable: The DO flag in an outgoing query's EDNS OPT pseudo-RR has an observable value.

requirements.quote:
A security-aware resolver MUST support a message size of at least
   1220 octets, SHOULD support a message size of 4000 octets, and MUST
   use the "sender's UDP payload size" field in the EDNS OPT pseudo-RR
   to advertise the message size that it is willing to accept.
requirements.required_behavior: The security-aware resolver MUST support a message size of at least 1220 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The supported message-size boundary can be inspected and exercised with messages of 1220 octets.

requirements.quote:
A security-aware resolver MUST support a message size of at least
   1220 octets, SHOULD support a message size of 4000 octets, and MUST
   use the "sender's UDP payload size" field in the EDNS OPT pseudo-RR
   to advertise the message size that it is willing to accept.
requirements.required_behavior: The security-aware resolver SHOULD support a message size of 4000 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: Support for 4000-octet messages can be inspected and exercised while retaining the advisory SHOULD modality.

requirements.quote:
A security-aware resolver MUST support a message size of at least
   1220 octets, SHOULD support a message size of 4000 octets, and MUST
   use the "sender's UDP payload size" field in the EDNS OPT pseudo-RR
   to advertise the message size that it is willing to accept.
requirements.condition: For a security-aware resolver advertising the message size it is willing to accept.
requirements.required_behavior: The security-aware resolver MUST advertise the message size it is willing to accept in the "sender's UDP payload size" field of the EDNS OPT pseudo-RR.
requirements.why_checkable: The EDNS OPT field can be compared with the resolver's configured or implemented accepted message size.

requirements.quote:
A
   security-aware resolver's IP layer MUST handle fragmented UDP packets
   correctly regardless of whether any such fragmented packets were
   received via IPv4 or IPv6.
requirements.condition: When fragmented UDP packets are received via IPv4 by a security-aware resolver.
requirements.required_behavior: The security-aware resolver's IP layer MUST handle the fragmented UDP packets correctly.
requirements.why_checkable: Delivery and handling of a UDP datagram fragmented over IPv4 can be exercised at the resolver's IP layer.

requirements.quote:
A
   security-aware resolver's IP layer MUST handle fragmented UDP packets
   correctly regardless of whether any such fragmented packets were
   received via IPv4 or IPv6.
requirements.condition: When fragmented UDP packets are received via IPv6 by a security-aware resolver.
requirements.required_behavior: The security-aware resolver's IP layer MUST handle the fragmented UDP packets correctly.
requirements.why_checkable: Delivery and handling of a UDP datagram fragmented over IPv6 can be exercised at the resolver's IP layer.
